task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Imperial-level coordination: declare epidemic emergency, unify command across ministries, and set daily reporting cadence
Emergency finance and census: open the relief treasury, requisition grain and medicine, track mortality by prefecture, and suppress price-gouging on staples
Enforce quarantine decrees, cordon infected wards and routes, prosecute hoarders and fraud-medicine sellers, and keep urban order
Deploy troops to seal affected cities, escort medical convoys, secure granaries and pharmacies, and run field triage and burial details
Convert temples and granaries into isolation wards, repair roads and waterworks for supply lines, and expand coffin and lime capacity for mass burial
